{{Quote|Whatever the reason, it was clear that this apparently simple R2 unit was more than just a Navigation Droid. It was also a loyal companion.|Keyan Farlander|<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
''' R2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that worked with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] during his [[Time/Legends|time]] serving on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']].<ref name="XW" />

==Biography==
[[File:Farlander_Shooting.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The R2 unit with Farlander, on board ''Talon'']]
The droid accompanied Farlander on his [[Battle in the Turkana system|first mission]] after training, during which Rebel fighter pilots assisted in the capture of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Talon_(Imperial_corvette)|''Talon'']]. Rebel commandos who boarded the ship radioed the pilots for a spare R2 unit to access the corvette's computers. Farlander flew his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] into the ''Talon''{{'s}} [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] and was led through the ship by the droid, who actually saved Farlander by rendering an attacking [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] unconscious with an electrical shock. Once the pair reached the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], the R2 shut down any operating [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and downloaded data from the ship's computer. After Farlander shot and killed an Imperial officer trying to destroy [[Datacard/Legends|data disks]], he and the R2 returned to their fighter and left the area with the rest of the Rebels.<ref name="XWOSG" />

The droid continued to fly with Farlander throughout his many starfighter missions. The droid would often meet Farlander in the hangar bay after the pilot returned from a mission flying a ship not requiring an astromech, such as an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] fighter.<ref name="XW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Farlander_R2_unit_-_SWXW.jpg|250px|thumb|The photo representing the R2 unit]]
R2 could be seen during cutscenes before and after missions in [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], and when a player changed to a rear-facing view while flying missions. It can occasionally can be heard at key points during the mission.<ref name="XW" />

The droid's role was expanded in the story of Farlander's first mission in ''[[The Farlander Papers]]'', reprinted and slightly expanded in ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''. The game allowed players to take part in the mission as part of a historical simulation which did not include the adventure inside the ''Talon''. The droid was represented in the guide by a black and white photo of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="XWOSG" />
